Delhi Police Detain Journalists During Jantar Mantar Protest Removal

Delhi Police removed protesters from Jantar Mantar, detaining journalists and snatching a microphone during the operation. The Quint described the event as a three-hour crackdown where individuals were "dragged, shoved," and protested against "Anti-Gyanesh."
